title: Reducing Permutation Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models via Shared Positions and Attention-Only Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28612v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on improving permutation robustness while preserving accuracy. First, we categorize permutation bias phenomena into four representative scenarios. Then, we take the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) dataset as an example under text-option reordering scenario to analyze the root cause of permutation bias. Based on this root cause analysis and set encoding strategy, we investigate shared positions with blocked cross-unit attention (SP-B) and extend this design to bidirectional cross-unit attention (SP-V) for modality exchange. However, these structural changes may reduce predictive accuracy. To recover model capability across different scenarios under the SP structure, an attention-only distillation from frozen native models is proposed. Shared positions reduce permutation sensitivity, and attention-only distillation improves accuracy under the shared-position structure. Across all three

translated_title: 通过共享位置与仅注意力蒸馏减少多模态大语言模型的排列敏感性
translated_abstract: 本文对如何在保持准确率的同时提升排列鲁棒性开展了系统性研究。首先，我们将排列偏差现象归纳为四种代表性场景；随后，以文本选项重排场景下的多选题问答（MCQA）数据集为例，分析排列偏差的根本原因。基于该根因分析与集合编码策略，我们研究了采用阻塞式跨单元注意力的共享位置方法（SP-B），并将该设计扩展为支持模态交换的双向跨单元注意力方法（SP-V）。然而，这些结构性改动可能会降低预测准确率。为了在共享位置（SP）结构下恢复模型在不同场景中的能力，我们提出了一种从冻结的原始模型进行的仅注意力蒸馏方法。共享位置降低了排列敏感性，而仅注意力蒸馏在共享位置结构下提升了准确率。在所有三种（场景中）……
tldr: 本文提出共享位置编码与仅注意力蒸馏相结合的方法，在降低多模态大语言模型排列敏感性的同时恢复了预测准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes shared positions combined with attention-only distillation to reduce permutation sensitivity in multimodal large language models while recovering predictive accuracy.
